lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows, with an observed increase in both inter-blob distance and diameter along the anterior-to-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating a rectilinear grid-like configuration in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending horizontally across the dorsal-lateral boundary, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher pixel values on the superior margin and cast shadows on the inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter, high-luminance circular points on the visible dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin.
